document_metadata.subject: Pelvic-Somatic Ascending Vectors and Anterior Boundary Barriers

discovered_operational_laws.description: Deep pelvic autonomic contractions send upward energy that climbs freely through highly primed, low-resistance posterior muscle layers (lower trapezius/skin), but experiences an absolute, immediate physical block at specific anterior fascial boundaries (infraumbilical region).

session_logs.somatic_trigger: Conscious contraction of involuntary pelvic/urinary muscle groups.

pathway_mapping.origin: Pelvic floor / internal deep pelvic cavity.
pathway_mapping.posterior_route: Migrated from internal to rear, traveling vertically up the lower back. Sensation intensity multiplied significantly upon entering the lower trapezius muscle group and surface skin layers before tapering off.
pathway_mapping.anterior_route: Immediately intercepted. 100% conscious awareness of an absolute boundary block localized precisely on the front side, directly below the infraumbilical (belly button) region.
